fields.statement: Which side records an answer, and how is a proxy answer worded? Rhiza cannot tell who answered an AskUserQuestion in the pane (the session record has no answered-by field), so captured picks always get 'picked by the owner' wording. I recommend: the guide keeps the run's capture as the default recorder of picks (the planner writes no Decision for a plain owner pick); a planner writes the Decision itself only when the capture's wording would be wrong: the answer came from a proxy (an orchestrator or arbiter answering for the owner) or it carries a ruling the capture can't word, using the proxy's wording (e.g. the arbiter wording) and the verbatim question field, so the capture skips it. No new answered-by field in the session record now.
